plain.li: [seer,cast] Sit down with me and I'll tell you what the next season will bring.
[seer,cast] Give me a moment, and I'll read what the coming season holds.
[seer,cast,tribal] Let me throw the bones into the ash and see how they fall.
[seer,cast,medieval] Let me lay out the cards and see what the season holds.
[seer,cast,industrial] Let me hold the pendulum over your map and see where it swings.
[seer,cast,spacer] Let me go through the readings and tell you what's coming.
[seer,word:frost] It will freeze here before the next season is over.
[seer,word:frost] The next season will be cold enough to freeze the ground.
[seer,word:cold] The next season will be cold, so keep the fires going.
[seer,word:cold] You'll want warm clothes next season.
[seer,word:mild] The next season will be mild, neither hot nor cold.
[seer,word:mild] Next season the weather will be kind to you.
[seer,word:warm] The next season will be warm.
[seer,word:warm] It will be warm here next season, warmer than now.
[seer,word:heat] The next season will be very hot, so keep water close.
[seer,word:heat] Next season the heat will be hard on you.
[seer,word:grows] Your fields will grow next season.
[seer,word:grows] Whatever you plant next season will come up.
[seer,word:bare] Nothing will grow in your fields next season.
[seer,word:bare] Don't count on the fields next season, they won't grow.
[seer,word:storesshort] Your stores won't last until things grow again.
[seer,word:storesshort] You don't have enough food put by for what's coming.
[seer,word:storesenough] You have enough food put by to see the season through.
[seer,word:storesenough] Your stores will last, you've done well there.
[seer,word:blades] People with weapons are coming here before long.
[seer,word:blades] Someone means to attack you, and soon.
[seer,word:blades,lowtech] I see blades at your gate before the season is out.
[seer,heard] That was worth hearing, I'll tell the others.
[seer,heard] I don't know how they know, but I believe them.
[seer,heard] Well, now we know what to get ready for.
[oneway,turn] Why did we all just turn round the same way?
[oneway,turn] Everyone stopped and looked the same way, even the animals.
[oneway,turn] I turned round without meaning to, and so did everyone else.
[oneway,turn] Look at the shadows, they're all pointing the same way.
[oneway,dead] We're all facing where the dead one lies.
[oneway,dead] Everyone turned towards the grave at once.
[oneway,grave] I wanted to come and stand here with {DEAD} for a while.
[oneway,grave] We all turned this way last night, so I came to see {DEAD}.
[oneway,found] This is where we were all looking, and here's {THING}.
[oneway,found] There's {THING} lying out here, it wasn't here yesterday.
[stone,touch] The stone is humming, I can feel it in my hand.
[stone,touch] It's warm, and it's buzzing like there's something inside.
[stone,touch] I've never heard a stone make a sound before.
[scroll,found] There's {THING} here under the dust, and it's still sealed.
[scroll,found] Someone left {THING} in here a very long time ago.
[scroll,found] Look at this, {THING}, and the seal hasn't been broken.
[charged,mage] My mana is full, I've never felt it come in so fast.
[charged,mage] The sky is pouring power into me tonight.
[charged,psycaster] My head is clear, my focus is coming back on its own.
[charged,psycaster] I can feel the psychic field getting stronger tonight.
[charged,sensitive] Something in the air is running right through me.
[charged,sensitive] My skin is prickling, can anyone else feel that?
[charged,burned] It came out of my hands too fast and burned them.
[charged,burned] My hands are burned, it was too much at once.
[enchanter,arrive] I work on weapons and gear, if you have something worth the trouble.
[enchanter,arrive] I can make one of your things better, for a fair price.
[enchanter,arrive,lowtech] I carve runes into blades and cloth, and they come out better.
[enchanter,work] Hold it still for me, this will take about an hour.
[enchanter,work] Stand there and don't let go of it until I'm done.
[enchanter,leave] Another time, then, I'll be on my way.
[enchanter,leave] No matter, there are other places on my road.
[enchanter,nosilver] You don't have the silver after all, so I'll go.
[enchanter,done] It feels different in my hands now, better made somehow.
[enchanter,done] Look at it, it's like it was made by a master.
[buried,knock] Did you hear that knocking under the ground?
[buried,knock] Something hit the ground from underneath, I felt it.
[buried,crack] The ground over there has cracked open since last night.
[buried,crack] It's knocking again, and now the earth is splitting.
[buried,found] So this is what was knocking under the ground: {THING}.
[buried,found] The ground opened up, and look what was in it.
[buried,waker] Something is climbing out of the ground, get back.
[buried,waker] There are dead people coming up out of that hole.
[deadroad,sight] There are people walking out there, and they look dead.
[deadroad,sight] Look at them walking in a line, they don't even look at us.
[deadroad,sight] I can see right through those people out there.
[pilgrims,pray] We'll pray here a while and then be on our way.
[pilgrims,pray] This is a good place to stop and pray.
[pilgrims,pray] Thank you for letting us stop here.
[pilgrims,token] We'll leave this here for the people who live in this place.
[pilgrims,token] A small thing to thank you, and now we go on.
[pilgrims,seen] Those pilgrims stopped at our place to pray.
[pilgrims,seen] It's good to see people praying here.
[othersky] Look up, the sky is the wrong colour tonight.
[othersky] Those aren't our stars, I don't know any of them.
[othersky] The whole sky has turned violet, come and look.
[othersky,spacer] None of these stars are on the charts.
[beast,word:hunted] You've killed {COUNT} of us in a few days, and we noticed.
[beast,word:hunted] Your people have taken too many of us lately.
[beast,word:coming] Someone is coming to fight you, and soon.
[beast,word:coming] There are people on their way here who mean you harm.
[beast,word:sick] You're sick, {NAME}, you should rest.
[beast,word:sick] You smell of sickness, go and lie down.
[beast,word:hungry] You're hungry, {NAME}, go and eat something.
[beast,word:hungry] You haven't eaten enough today.
[beast,word:tired] You're worn out, {NAME}, go to sleep.
[beast,word:tired] You need to sleep, you can barely stand.
[beast,word:sad] You're unhappy, {NAME}, and the others can see it.
[beast,word:sad] Something is weighing on you, talk to someone about it.
[beast,word:watched] Something old is watching your colony.
[beast,word:watched] Something has been watching your colony for a long time.
[beast,heard] That animal just spoke to me, I heard every word.
[beast,heard] Did anyone else hear that, or was it just me?
[beast,heard] It talked to me and then walked off like a normal animal.
[godpasses,dawn] Something went past us in the night, and it didn't stop.
[godpasses,dawn] All those signs last night, and now nothing.
[godpasses,dawn,named] {GOD} went past us in the night.
[godpasses,dawn,named] Those were {GOD}'s signs, it went right past us.
[godpasses,dawn,scoffer] A lot of strange things at night, that's all it was.
[godpasses,dawn,scoffer] People will say it was a god, but nobody saw anything.
[spiritpack,seen] There's a pack of white wolves running round the colony.
[spiritpack,seen] Look at those wolves, they're running round us without a sound.
[spiritpack,seen] I can't hear their feet at all, those wolves.
[spiritpack,tracks] They ran right through here last night, and there isn't a single track.
[spiritpack,tracks] No tracks at all, as if nothing ran here.
[spiritpack,tracks,snow] The snow is smooth here, and they ran right across it.
[spiritpack,tracks,snow] Not a mark in the snow where those wolves ran.
[watched,eyes] There are eyes out there at the edge of the dark.
[watched,eyes] Something out there is looking at us, I can see its eyes.
[watched,eyes] Those eyes haven't moved since I first saw them.
[watched,walk] I'll go out and see what it is.
[watched,walk] Stay here, I'm going out to have a look.
[watched,nothing] They all went out as I got close, and there's nothing here.
[watched,nothing] Nothing here at all, not even tracks.
